title: 将数组清空
summary: 每次若数组首元素是当前最小值就删除，否则把首元素移到末尾；数组元素互异，求清空数组的操作次数。
insight: 元素删除顺序固定为数值升序。Fenwick 树维护原下标中仍存在的元素；设当前队首对应原下标 current，到目标下标 target 的操作数就是环形区间内存活元素数（包含 target）。删除 target 后队首从 target+1 继续。
pitfalls: 移动与删除都各算一次操作
区间计数只包含仍存活元素
target 位于 current 左侧时要拆成尾段与头段

solutions.title: 排序下标与 Fenwick 环形计数
solutions.idea: 按值顺序查询从当前队首到目标的存活数量。
steps: 按 nums 值升序排序原下标 order
Fenwick 初始每个位置为一
遍历 target：若 target>=current 查询 [current,target]，否则查询 [current,n-1]+[0,target]
累加区间存活数，Fenwick 删除 target

code.java: class Solution { static class Fenwick{int[] tree;Fenwick(int n){tree=new int[n+1];}void add(int index,int delta){for(index++;index<tree.length;index+=index&-index)tree[index]+=delta;}int sum(int index){int answer=0;for(index++;index>0;index-=index&-index)answer+=tree[index];return answer;}int range(int left,int right){return left>right?0:sum(right)-(left==0?0:sum(left-1));}}public long countOperationsToEmptyArray(int[] nums){Integer[] order=new Integer[nums.length];Fenwick fenwick=new Fenwick(nums.length);for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){order[i]=i;fenwick.add(i,1);}Arrays.sort(order,Comparator.comparingInt(index->nums[index]));long answer=0;int current=0;for(int target:order){answer+=target>=current?fenwick.range(current,target):fenwick.range(current,nums.length-1)+fenwick.range(0,target);fenwick.add(target,-1);current=(target+1)%nums.length;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countOperationsToEmptyArray(nums:IntArray):Long{val n=nums.size;val tree=IntArray(n+1);fun add(indexInput:Int,delta:Int){var index=indexInput+1;while(index<=n){tree[index]+=delta;index+=index and -index}};fun sum(indexInput:Int):Int{var index=indexInput+1;var result=0;while(index>0){result+=tree[index];index-=index and -index};return result};fun range(left:Int,right:Int):Int{return if(left>right)0 else sum(right)-(if(left==0)0 else sum(left-1))};for(i in nums.indices)add(i,1);val order=nums.indices.sortedBy{nums[it]};var answer=0L;var current=0;for(target in order){answer+=(if(target>=current)range(current,target) else range(current,n-1)+range(0,target));add(target,-1);current=(target+1)%n};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { struct Fenwick{vector<int> tree;Fenwick(int n):tree(n+1){}void add(int index,int delta){for(++index;index<(int)tree.size();index+=index&-index)tree[index]+=delta;}int sum(int index){int answer=0;for(++index;index>0;index-=index&-index)answer+=tree[index];return answer;}int range(int left,int right){return left>right?0:sum(right)-(left?sum(left-1):0);}};public:long long countOperationsToEmptyArray(vector<int>& nums){int n=nums.size();vector<int> order(n);iota(order.begin(),order.end(),0);sort(order.begin(),order.end(),[&](int a,int b){return nums[a]<nums[b];});Fenwick fenwick(n);for(int i=0;i<n;++i)fenwick.add(i,1);long long answer=0;int current=0;for(int target:order){answer+=target>=current?fenwick.range(current,target):fenwick.range(current,n-1)+fenwick.range(0,target);fenwick.add(target,-1);current=(target+1)%n;}return answer;} };
